chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Sinan, from Yahya, the brother of Udaym, from al-Walid ibn Subayh, who said:
I heard Aba Abdillah عليه السلام saying: "Indeed, this matter is not claimed by anyone other than its rightful owner except that Allah cuts off his life."

key_terms.هَذَا الْأَمْرَ: this matter; the divinely appointed authority referred to in context
key_terms.يَدَّعِيهِ: claims it; asserts possession of that authority

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about falsely claiming the Imamate?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms the gravity of falsely claiming the divinely designated authority of the Imamate. It presents such a claim as a serious transgression against religious authority, with a severe divine consequence attached to it.
